sources.entry: Aerial - Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Aerial is the historical repository for the Aerial Apple TV aerial-views screen saver for macOS, distributed as a legacy .saver bundle.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this repository as the historical home of Aerial, an Apple TV-style aerial views screen saver distributed as a .saver file. It states that version 4.0 was rewritten as an App Extension and is now bundled into the former updater app (Aerial Companion), which has been renamed Aerial.app. The README itself is very short and does not describe installation steps, settings, or the video sources in detail. It links to an App Repository and a Website, but the link URLs are empty in the text provided.
use_cases: set an Apple TV-style aerial screensaver on a Mac
find the legacy .saver version of Aerial
locate the newer Aerial.app for macOS
browse history of the Aerial screensaver project
notable: Legacy .saver repository; the current version 4.0+ ships as an App Extension inside Aerial.app
Aerial Companion updater app was renamed to Aerial.app
Apple TV aerial views style screensaver for macOS
caveats: This is the historical .saver version; current development moved to the Aerial.app bundle
README gives no install or run instructions and its app and website links are blank
keywords: screensaver for mac with apple tv videos
